articles.title: CVE-2026-18481 — CVSS 7.3
articles.summary:
Stored cross-site scripting in the participant URL handling in AWS Ops 
Wheel before PR #168 might allow an authenticated remote user to steal 
session tokens and escalate to full administrative control of the 
deployed instance via a crafted participant_url value containing a 
dangerous URI scheme.






To remediate this issue, users should redeploy from the latest version of aws-ops-wheel.

articles.title: CVE-2026-55100
articles.summary: hashi-vault-js is a Node.js module for interacting with the HashiCorp Vault API. Prior to 0.5.2, src/Vault.js concatenates unencoded identifier values including name, username, group, role, and version into Vault request paths and query strings instead of using encodeURIComponent() and URLSearchParams, allowing path traversal and query parameter injection. This issue is fixed in version 0.5.2.

articles.title: CVE-2026-54729
articles.summary: DSSRF is a Node.js library that provides a wide range of utilities and advanced SSRF defense checks. Prior to 1.0.5, is_url_safe can treat localhost as safe when DNS resolver 1.1.1.1 returns NXDOMAIN because dns.resolve4 yields no address and no dns.lookup fallback occurs, allowing server-side request forgery. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.5.
